correctness.rationale: From Leibniz identities and no isolated vertices, derivations are exactly blockwise symmetric zero-row-sum matrices. Their B_{ij} basis gives triangle brackets and the binary cycle space as the first derived term. Triangle brackets span four-cycles, of dimension C(t−1,2)−1 for t≥4. For seven distinct indices, [C_{ab|ef},C_{cd|eg}]=C_{ab|cd}; this makes the second derived term perfect for every t≥7. The exact binary structure-constant checker and a separate direct-matrix checker both compute all derived dimensions for t≤7, establishing finite exceptional cases over every char-two extension field by rank invariance. Full proof and reproducible scripts provided.
